description.narrative: (Ethiopia): The USAID Healthy Behaviors Activity increases sustained adoption of appropriate health and nutrition behaviors to reduce maternal and child mortality. It focuses primarily at the district level and below to ensure communities can act to improve their own health. The activity will promote behavior change to support improved maternal and child health, family planning and reproductive health, nutrition, water hygiene and sanitation (WASH), and infectious disease management, including malaria. ..Based on proven approaches that address drivers for health beliefs and behaviors at the individual, family, and community levels, the Activity will promote social behavior change that supports healthy behaviors and improved health outcomes...The activity increases demand by community members for health services; builds service providers' communication skills for improved patient interactions; supports use of districts and communities' traditional communication platforms for community mobilization and health campaigns; and builds capacity of local organizations to coordinate for gender transformative programming. ..The activity will be implemented in Amhara, Benishangul Gumuz, Gambella, Oromia, Southern Nations, Nationalities and Peoples', and Sidama Regions.......... .
